Name: Zanoah in the Hill Country
ModernLocation: Unknown; possibly Khirbet Beit Amra, in the hill country of Judah
Description: A town in Judah's hill country named in Joshua's allotment, distinct from the Zanoah of the lowland named with Nehemiah's wall builders.
BiblicalSignificance: Zanoah in the Hill Country is the hill-country namesake of the lowland Zanoah.
